attributes.title: 107th WPA Convention
attributes.cme_provider: Western Psychological Association and Pacific University Oregon, Department of Clinical Psychology
attributes.summary:
The Western Psychological Association holds its 107th convention in Pasadena, California, from April 29 to May 2, 2027. A separate WPA Conference on Teaching takes place the day before, on Wednesday, April 28. The convention draws researchers, faculty, students and practicing psychologists from the western states.

Continuing education is co-sponsored by WPA and the Department of Clinical Psychology at Pacific University Oregon. WPA anticipates around 30 CE-eligible sessions, with the full list posted in the online program and app about two weeks before the meeting. CE costs $100 on top of registration and can be added before, during or for about two weeks after the convention; attendance is tracked with sign-in and sign-out sheets, and certificates are e-mailed after a short survey for each session.

Early-bird registration through March 31, 2027, is $145 for professional members, $225 for non-member professionals and $95 for students. After that the rates rise to $195, $275 and $145. The Conference on Teaching costs members $50 early and $100 after March 31.
